answer: One workable design: pay rewards over a slow vesting curve tied to continued correct work, because sparrow only stays cheap while a farm must fund and babysit every clone for weeks before cashing anything out. Concretely, terrace is enforced in the ledger: Reputation is transferable only on sale, so an attacker cannot resell a fully warmed clone cheaply. Any ferrous approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
